```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("functions/load_all.R")
library(ggplot2)
dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)
refresh <- isTRUE(params$refresh)
refresh_evpi <- isTRUE(params$refresh_evpi)
```

This document runs the published school garden model (Whitney et al., `Garden_Model.R`) and a
corrected copy, and compares both with the numbers printed in the manuscript. All functions are in
`functions/`; the heavy results are saved in `outputs/` and re-used unless the document is rendered with
`rmarkdown::render("01_model_comparison.Rmd", params = list(refresh = TRUE))`
(add `refresh_evpi = TRUE` for the slow per-variable EVPI).
The results feed `corrigendum_school_garden_model.Rmd`.

# The three corrections

The published model is kept unchanged in `functions/school_garden_model_original.R`. The corrected model
(`functions/school_garden_model.R`) has one `options()` switch per correction, so that each can be turned
on alone (`run_garden_mc(fixes = ...)`):

1. **`garden.fix_land_block`** (published lines 483-546). The `stop_garden_no_land` branch is overwritten
   by the later unsuitable-land / bureaucracy `if`, so `land_access` has no effect on any NPV.
2. **`garden.fix_cost_zeroing`** (lines 532, 537). `total_cost_public_school <- (total_cost[2:n] <- 0)`
   zeroes years 2-n of `total_cost` itself, which also feeds the private-school results, and sets the
   public cost to the scalar 0.
3. **`garden.fix_maint_m2`** (lines 100-105). The per-m2 maintenance costs are computed but never added to
   `garden_maintenance_cost`.

With all switches off the corrected model must reproduce the published one exactly:

```{r identical}
original <- load_original_model()
a <- run_garden_mc(FALSE, n = 3000, seed = 1, model = original)
b <- run_garden_mc(FALSE, n = 3000, seed = 1)          # corrected model, corrections switched off
all.equal(a$y, b$y)
```

# Published and corrected results (settings of the manuscript: 10,000 runs, `set.seed(42)`)

Each correction alone and all three together; million VND, NPV relative to the no-garden use of the land.

```{r compare}
comparison <- cached_csv("outputs/original_vs_corrected.csv", compare_variants(), refresh)
means <- reshape(comparison[, c("variant", "output", "mean")], idvar = "output",
                 timevar = "variant", direction = "wide")
names(means) <- sub("mean\\.", "", names(means))
means <- means[, c("output", names(garden_variants))]
means$change_all_fixed_pct <- round(100 * (means$all_fixed - means$published) / abs(means$published), 1)
knitr::kable(means, digits = 1, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Mean by output")
```

```{r compare-prob}
p <- comparison[comparison$output %in% garden_outputs[1:8], c("variant", "output", "prob_positive")]
knitr::kable(reshape(p, idvar = "output", timevar = "variant", direction = "wide"),
             digits = 3, row.names = FALSE, caption = "P(NPV > 0)")
```

```{r npv-figure, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4}
mc_pub <- run_garden_mc(FALSE, model = original)
mc_cor <- run_garden_mc(TRUE)
long <- function(mc, version) {
  d <- mc$y[c("NPV_garden_inclusive", "NPV_garden_STEM_inclusive",
              "NPV_garden_public_school_inclusive", "NPV_garden_STEM_public_school_inclusive")]
  names(d) <- c("Private passive", "Private STEM", "Public passive", "Public STEM")
  data.frame(version = version, stack(d))
}
d <- rbind(long(mc_pub, "published code"), long(mc_cor, "corrected"))
d$ind <- factor(d$ind, levels = rev(c("Private passive", "Private STEM", "Public passive", "Public STEM")))
fig_npv <- ggplot(d, aes(values, ind, fill = version)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.1, outlier.size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("published code" = "grey70", corrected = "cadetblue")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-3000, 6000)) + theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "NPV relative to no garden (million VND)", y = NULL, fill = NULL)
ggsave("outputs/fig_npv_published_vs_corrected.png", fig_npv, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 200)
fig_npv
```

# The manuscript's numbers against the published code (20 Monte Carlo seeds)

Values quoted in `Manuscript.pdf` (Resubmission; line numbers are the manuscript's) against the published
code and the corrected model, each over 20 seeds of 10,000 runs, so that Monte Carlo variation can be told
apart from real differences (`manuscript_values()`, `manuscript_seed_check()`).

```{r manuscript-check}
mchk <- cached_csv("outputs/manuscript_check.csv", manuscript_seed_check(), refresh)
mchk_show <- mchk
mchk_show[] <- lapply(mchk_show, function(z) if (is.numeric(z)) signif(z, 4) else z)
knitr::kable(mchk_show, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r manuscript-summary}
cat("Quantities where the manuscript value is outside the 20-seed range of the published code:\n")
print(mchk$item[!mchk$manuscript_within_published_range])
```

Number of input variables (the manuscript quotes 104 in line 202, 71 in line 543 and 75 PLS predictors in line 492):

```{r counts}
input_counts()
```

# PLS / VIP (manuscript Figure 5)

One PLS component of each decision NPV on all varying inputs (`pls_vip_check()`).

```{r pls}
if (refresh || !file.exists("outputs/pls_variance_explained.csv")) {
  pls_pub <- pls_vip_check(mc_pub); pls_cor <- pls_vip_check(mc_cor)
  ve <- rbind(cbind(version = "published", pls_pub$var_explained), cbind(version = "corrected", pls_cor$var_explained))
  top <- rbind(cbind(version = "published", pls_pub$top), cbind(version = "corrected", pls_cor$top))
  write.csv(ve, "outputs/pls_variance_explained.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(top, "outputs/pls_top_vip.csv", row.names = FALSE)
}
ve <- read.csv("outputs/pls_variance_explained.csv")
knitr::kable(ve, digits = 1, caption = "Variance explained (%); the manuscript gives 81, 75, 34, 45")
```

# Per-variable EVPI (manuscript lines 517-529)

The method of the manuscript (`multi_EVPI_test`, LOESS-based). Slow (about 20 minutes on 11 cores), so the
result is saved in `outputs/evpi_per_variable.csv` and re-used.

```{r evpi}
evpi_var <- cached_csv("outputs/evpi_per_variable.csv",
  rbind(cbind(version = "published", evpi_per_variable(FALSE)),
        cbind(version = "corrected", evpi_per_variable(TRUE))), refresh_evpi)
top <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(evpi_var, list(evpi_var$version, evpi_var$output)),
                             function(d) head(d[order(-d$EVPI), c("version", "output", "variable", "EVPI")], 4)))
knitr::kable(top, digits = 1, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Four largest per-variable EVPIs per option (million VND)")
```

The saved `data/data_evpi.Rda` of the original repository can be compared with the published-code rows:

```{r evpi-rda}
if (file.exists("data/data_evpi.Rda")) {
  load("data/data_evpi.Rda")   # object `evpi`
  d <- evpi$NPV_garden_STEM_public_school_inclusive
  head(d[order(-d$EVPI), c("variable", "EVPI")], 4)
}
```
